sources.role: PUAE libretro core config-layer, input mapper, save and firmware source
native RetroArch host config, save/state/system path source
native RetroArch PUAE launch and configuration boundary

paths.path: ~/.config/retroarch/retroarch.cfg (or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/retroarch/retroarch.cfg); native launch injects a private save-directory override.
paths.naming: RetroArch key = value syntax; PUAE custom layers are puae_libretro_<MODEL>.uae, puae_libretro_global.uae and <content-basename>.uae in the effective save directory.

paths.path: RetroArch per-port input_playerN_* bindings plus PUAE's six frontend ports; Lunchbox's native launch resolves and guards model-specific PUAE mappings.
paths.naming: PUAE mapper selects ordinary joystick, CD32/CD32FR gamepad, or mouse semantics from core options; generated host bindings remain private to the launch.

paths.path: ~/.config/retroarch/saves/ when explicitly resolved by RetroArch settings; otherwise the effective content directory.
paths.naming: <content-basename>.srm and core/content-sorted sidecars; PUAE custom .uae layers share the effective save directory.

paths.path: ~/.config/retroarch/states/ when explicitly resolved; otherwise the effective content directory.
paths.naming: <content-basename>.state, .stateN, .state.auto and optional .entry forms; savestate slots are frontend-owned.

paths.path: ~/.config/retroarch/system/ (or explicit RetroArch system_directory).
paths.naming: PUAE puae_libretro.info firmware paths include machine-dependent Kickstart files such as kick34005.A500, kick40068.A1200, kick40060.CD32 and kick40060.CD32.ext; requiredness and MD5 notes are core-declared.

paths.path: No cryptographic key file is used by the PUAE core contract.
paths.naming: Not applicable.

paths.path: ~/.var/app/org.libretro.RetroArch/config/retroarch/retroarch.cfg; native PUAE guard currently rejects Flatpak namespace launches.
paths.naming: RetroArch key = value syntax; PUAE custom layers use the same three .uae names in the effective save directory.

paths.path: RetroArch/PUAE per-port input and autoconfig paths inside the Flatpak namespace.
paths.naming: Same PUAE mapper device semantics; namespace translation is not yet implemented by the native Lunchbox guard.

controller_boundary.refusal: The native launch guard refuses Flatpak/custom-environment paths, unknown models, non-UTF-8/overlong paths, and substantive custom .uae layers until effective input is resolved; it never edits user files.

notes: PUAE here means the native RetroArch launch path with the PUAE core and Lunchbox's real save-directory/config-layer guard. The separate puae-retroarch catalog entry is documentation-oriented and is not a second native writer. Runtime package and gameplay verification remain incomplete.
